exposure: time period (pre-pandemic, 1st wave and lockdown, June-August, September-October, 2nd wave and lockdown)

calendar months in 2020 vs. similar calendar months in 2019 for five periods [Jan-Feb (pre-pandemic); March-May (1st wave and lockdown); June-August; September-October; November-December (2nd wave and lockdown)]
finding: This study found significant reductions in preterm and LBW births, possibly due to the indirect effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, but also an increase in CS rates.
mod_finding: The rate of CS in hospital births increased from 57.7% in 2019 to 60.2% in 2020, with significant increases during the 3rd and 4th periods of the study.
